what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Timor-Leste in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1520 Timorese asylum seekers, and Australia hosted 88.5% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are Israel, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Timor-Leste, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 19 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
